title: 第二十九章 首次版本大升级
content_zh:
第二十九章 首次版本大升级-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》

上一章

存书签

下一章

【奖励已发放，请宿主再接再厉】

【新任务：请在一个月之内成功让一百名幸存者觉醒。

任务奖励：奖励虚拟店铺，可不再限制任何范围，让即便是远在千里之外的幸存者也能够购买或者是接取任务

诸神温馨提示：一个月之后，末世游戏将迎来首次版本大更新，届时，所有怪物的能力都将得到再次增强】

在看到新任务的内容之后，爻雪刚刚完成任务的喜悦瞬间消失得无影无踪，整个人差点一口气没喘上来，就连刚到手的辅助机器人都没心思研究了。

“这里的事就暂时交给你们了，我还有其他事情，另外，如果苏辰他们回来，通知他们来找我。”说完，爻雪朝着柜台后面走去，身影很快就消失不见了。

爻雪并不是坐以待毙的性格，既然系统给出了任务，那就去完成，她现在最头疼的是那个首次版本大更新。

已知的，如今的蓝星之中她是唯一的NPC，也只有她才能够让人觉醒异能，但整个蓝星如此之大，只靠她一个人的话，根本就顾不过来。

“还是得加大异能觉醒药剂的产量才行。”爻雪这样喃喃自语着。

她先是来到仓库，从里面拿出了一个最大的铁锅，将其扛到了楼顶，然后她用结界凭空搭建了一个炉灶的形状，将大铁锅放在了上面，不大不小，正正好好。

结界这个异能虽然战斗力有点拉胯，但用处还是挺广泛的，她现在甚至能够利用结界凭空搭建出一处房子，而且结界还能够模拟其他环境，就比如…

随着爻雪的心念一动，一簇火焰从结界搭建的炉灶里面窜出，这样一来，不知道省去了多少燃料呢。

爻雪拿出了早就准备好的锅铲以及她手里所有的晶核，一共是三百七十二枚。

三十枚就能制作出一瓶异能觉醒药剂，这三百七十二枚晶核一共能制作三十二瓶药剂，还差六十八瓶，不对，应该更多。

因为异能觉醒药剂并不能保证百分之百觉醒。

这批药剂她并不准备随缘卖出去，而是准备跟苏辰合作。

从苏辰小队来她这里的第一天她就知道这些人是军人，所以她准备跟他们合作，由他们挑选出一百人来服用异能觉醒药剂，完成任务的同时还要应对一个月之后的首次版本升级。

content_en:
Chapter 29 The first major version upgrade - "Apocalyptic Invasion: I am an NPC in the dungeon"

Previous chapter

Save bookmarks

Next chapter

[Rewards have been distributed, please host to keep up the good work]

[New mission: Please successfully awaken one hundred survivors within a month.

Mission rewards: The reward virtual store is no longer restricted to any scope, so that even survivors thousands of miles away can purchase or receive missions.

Warm reminder from the gods: In one month, the apocalyptic game will usher in its first major version update, at which time the abilities of all monsters will be enhanced again]

After seeing the content of the new mission, Yaoxue's joy at completing the mission disappeared instantly. She almost couldn't breathe. She didn't even bother to study the auxiliary robot she had just received.

"I'll leave the affairs here to you for the time being. I have other things to do. In addition, if Su Chen and the others come back, notify them to come find me." After saying that, Yaoxue walked towards the back of the counter, and her figure quickly disappeared.

Yaoxue is not the type to sit still and wait for death. Since the system has given a task, she will complete it. Her biggest headache now is the first major version update.

It is known that she is the only NPC in Blue Star today, and only she can awaken people's abilities. However, the entire Blue Star is so big that she alone cannot take care of it.

"We still need to increase the production of power awakening potions." Yaoxue muttered to herself.

She first came to the warehouse, took out the largest iron pot from it, and carried it to the roof. Then she used the barrier to build a stove shape out of thin air, and placed the big iron pot on it. It was not too big or too small, just right.

Although the battle power of the barrier is a bit stretched, it is still very useful. She can even use the barrier to build a house out of thin air, and the barrier can also simulate other environments, such as...

Following Yaoxue's thoughts, a bunch of flames burst out from the stove built by the barrier. In this way, I don't know how much fuel was saved.

Yaoxue took out the spatula she had prepared long ago and all the crystal nuclei in her hand, a total of 372.

Thirty crystal cores can make a bottle of potion for awakening powers. These 372 crystal cores can make a total of thirty-two bottles of potion. There are still 68 bottles left. No, there should be more.

Because the power awakening potion does not guarantee 100% awakening.

She was not going to sell this batch of potions casually, but was going to cooperate with Su Chen.

She knew from the first day Su Chen's team came to her that these people were soldiers, so she was ready to cooperate with them and let them select a hundred people to take the power awakening potion. While completing the task, they also had to deal with the first version upgrade in a month's time.
